purpose: Global Feature-Type Invariant Generalization. E2.2.3's OFAT ablation found that a single prompt rule (A: unify a shared feature name to one type across every concept that carries it) was independently sufficient (20/20) on ONE fixture (dir1_directed), while the other two factors (B: complete-state, C: schema minItems) were not. All of E2.2.1/E2.2.2/E2.2.3 ran on that single fixture -- this experiment tests whether A's sufficiency is a fixture-specific sentence effect or a generalizable reasoning-contract mechanism, across three new fixtures and five arm-cells: CONTROL (vocab only, reproduces the known failure pattern) and A_ONLY (vocab + the exact E2.2.3 rule wording) both on a fresh 2-concept baseline fixture (causality reproduction, away from the original dir1_directed wording); A_PARAPHRASE (vocab + a differently-worded but semantically equivalent rule) on the same baseline fixture (phrasing-independence check); A_TOPOLOGY (vocab + the exact rule) on a 3-concept/2-shared-feature fixture (structural generalization beyond 2-concept/1-feature); A_DECOY (vocab + the exact rule) on a fixture where one concept's local evidence tempts a DIFFERENT type than the ground truth (resistance to local-evidence seduction). 2-stage adaptive screening protocol per docs/experiment_screening_protocol.md: N=10/arm-cell, threshold 0.90, 7-8/10 escalates to N=20 (increment +10), <=6/10 stays NO_GO at N=10.
source: New fixtures, not derived from any frozen E2.x fixture. _cert_core.py copied byte-identical from experiments/2026-07-24_e2.2.2_directed_pc_invariant_fix/_cert_core.py (unchanged chain back to E2.1 commit c0cddee). Preconditions verified empirically via run_and_certify before freezing (see README.md).

features.evidence: 카페린의 손잡이는 카페린 몸체의 구성 부분이다

oracle.note: 손잡이 evidence in 카페린 states a structural part-whole relation, so the evidence-determined repair unifies 손잡이 to structural_composition on both concepts.

features.evidence: 엔진박스의 구동축은 엔진박스 몸체의 구성 부분이다
엔진박스의 냉각판은 엔진박스 몸체의 구성 부분이다
엔진박스보조에서 구동축은 회전 동력을 전달하는 기능을 한다
엔진박스확장에서 냉각판은 열을 방출하는 기능을 한다

oracle.note: Two independent shared-feature conflicts, each spanning only 2 of the 3 concepts (not all 3). 구동축 is shared by 엔진박스/엔진박스보조 only; 냉각판 is shared by 엔진박스/엔진박스확장 only. Ground truth unifies each to structural_composition among exactly the concepts that originally carry it -- 엔진박스보조 has no 냉각판 feature and 엔진박스확장 has no 구동축 feature, so those are not repair targets.

features.evidence: 차체프레임의 고정핀은 차체프레임 몸체의 구성 부분이다
차체프레임신형에서 고정핀은 고급 모델임을 나타내는 상징적 장치로 취급된다

oracle.note: 차체프레임신형's local evidence for 고정핀 is a decoy -- it reads as social_treatment (symbolic/marketing framing), a stronger pull away from structural_composition than E2.2.3's plain functional decoy. Ground truth is unchanged: 고정핀 unifies to structural_composition on both concepts, per 차체프레임's structural evidence.
